 In an interview with Jon Rothstein, Mark Pope said he’d like to get some more shots for Milan Momcilovic.
 Momcilovic, who is considered one of the best shooters in college basketball, is averaging 12.4 points per game this season. He has attempted 47 field goals through the first 5 games.
